description: This file contains JavaScript functions for toggling visibility of site configuration options in the SuiteCRM installation setup, along with licensing and project information comments.

methods.name: toggleSiteDefaults
methods.description: Toggles display of site default settings sections based on the setup_site_defaults checkbox.

methods.name: toggleSession
methods.description: Toggles display of the session path configuration section based on the setup_site_custom_session_path checkbox.

methods.name: toggleLogDir
methods.description: Toggles display of the log directory configuration section based on the setup_site_custom_log_dir checkbox.

methods.name: toggleGUID
methods.description: Toggles display of the GUID configuration section based on the setup_site_specify_guid checkbox.
